authority: Complete workflow files in this versioned public package.

prompts.title: Client Discovery & Project Scoping Prompt
prompts.intent: Qualify prospective work, understand the client's underlying problem and users, establish scope, constraints, risks and feasibility, and prepare an evidence-based discovery brief. No premature solution or price commitments.

prompts.title: Project Proposal, Estimation & Statement of Work Prompt
prompts.intent: Prepare or review clear deliverables, exclusions, estimates, commercial options, milestones, acceptance criteria, third-party costs and scope changes. Works without prior discovery.

prompts.title: Client Contract & Agreement Drafting Prompt
prompts.intent: Draft and review jurisdiction-aware service agreements, NDAs, amendments and terms for fees, IP, liability, privacy, termination and handover. Clearly flags unagreed terms and legal review; never claims execution.

prompts.title: Client Onboarding & Project Kickoff Prompt
prompts.intent: Prepare onboarding, client responsibilities, secure access and asset requests, kickoff agendas, working arrangements and initial project readiness. Doesn't require another prompt or authorise account changes.

prompts.title: Project Delivery & Change Management Prompt
prompts.intent: Manage milestones, task progress, risks, client communications, feedback, scope changes, approvals and project transition against the agreed baseline. Separates change requests from accepted scope and implementation.

prompts.title: AI Product Development Prompt
prompts.intent: Define product foundations, architecture, technical acceptance, security and safe releases. Audit six documentation functions across existing authoritative sources, check them against code and tests, and verify continuity for a fresh AI assistant session without requiring six separate files.

prompts.title: Product Discovery, Market Validation & Monetisation Strategy Prompt
prompts.intent: Assess new or existing SaaS and digital product opportunities through real customer evidence, market alternatives, small validation tests, willingness to pay, pricing, packaging and unit economics. Recommend whether to proceed, refine, test or stop.

prompts.title: Product Analytics, User Activation & Retention Optimisation Prompt
prompts.intent: Define trustworthy product events and metrics, measure first value, feature use and retention across user or account cohorts, diagnose churn and test improvements. Works for new or existing SaaS and other digital products without imposing a vendor.

prompts.title: UI, UX & Design Engineering Prompt
prompts.intent: Design and implement consistent, accessible website and app interfaces with reusable components. Verify responsive menus, logo-home and phone/email links, truthful progress, accessible feedback, stable loading and recovery, visual alignment and real journeys against approved designs.

prompts.title: Visual Preference Discovery & Design System Creation Prompt
prompts.intent: Analyse supplied visual references to clarify preferred styles, establish coherent design direction, choose only free UI foundations licensed for the intended use, and create reusable tokens, component contracts and alignment rules. Includes specimen and actual rendering checks, without requiring 3.1 first.

prompts.title: AI Agent Engineering Prompt
prompts.intent: Design or review agents, architecture, bounded delegation and shared budgets, tool permissions, persistent memory, approvals, recoverable execution and audit history.

prompts.title: Security & Authentication Engineering Prompt
prompts.intent: Assess authentication, password/reset/session security, admin and tenant access, secrets, storage and Git-history leaks. Verify security controls, activity logs, SDK consent and data rights; distinguish severity, exposure, evidence confidence and risk-based remediation.

prompts.title: Backend, Database & API Integration Engineering Prompt
prompts.intent: Implement and verify backend data, APIs, migrations, jobs and integrations, including server-side form validation, parameterised queries and safe file uploads. Scope traceable errors and attributable admin or business history as needed. Verify authoritative job status, cancellation and recovery without duplicate effects.

prompts.title: Payments, Subscription Billing & Digital Product Fulfilment Engineering Prompt
prompts.intent: Implement checkout, subscriptions, refunds, digital fulfilment and entitlements with verified provider events, recovery and attributable financial or access changes.

prompts.title: Full-Stack Feature Development & Refactoring Prompt
prompts.intent: Own full-stack SaaS feature implementation and refactoring across application layers, contracts, migrations, UI state, integrated tests and acceptance. Verify authoritative job status, cancellation and recovery without duplicate effects.

prompts.title: AI Application, RAG & Model Integration Engineering Prompt
prompts.intent: Own non-agent AI application engineering, eligible model routing, bounded context and structured outputs, permission-controlled RAG, retrieval baselines, grounding, index migration, safety and cost.

prompts.title: Data Engineering, Analytics Pipelines & BI Prompt
prompts.intent: Own data engineering and analytics pipelines, including source ingestion, ETL/ELT, warehouse models, data quality, reproducible analysis, BI and statistical engineering.

prompts.title: LLM Evaluation, Quality & AI Operations Prompt
prompts.intent: Own independent LLM quality and operations, held-out evaluation, authorised retrieval and claim-level citations, agent effects/delegation/recovery/memory tests, business validity, non-vacuous gates, telemetry and controlled releases.

prompts.title: Project Testing and Quality Assurance Prompt
prompts.intent: Test app and website functionality, security, scalability and independent design or editorial acceptance. Verify routes/templates, navigation/footer links, buttons, forms, placeholder copy, mobile menus, overflow, imagery and asynchronous status/retry/cancellation effects. Report untested and failed mandatory criteria.

prompts.title: Content and Documentation Governance Prompt
prompts.intent: Establish reusable content foundations for voice, messaging, writing patterns and SEO. AI self-review checks outputs against independently defined editorial criteria and must reject unnatural yet technically valid copy. External validators remain optional.

prompts.title: Transactional & Marketing Email Communications, Compliance & Lifecycle Engineering Prompt
prompts.intent: Classify and govern transactional, security, service and marketing emails. Verify recipient-specific legal requirements, consent, unsubscribes, accessible templates, delivery and tests while protecting essential notices.

prompts.title: SEO and AEO Audit Prompt
prompts.intent: Read-only multi-platform SEO/AEO audit, incident diagnosis and per-URL evidence. Required llms.txt, useful FAQ/FAQPage and numerical keyword evidence; sourced page-specific targets, search/AI evidence, local/ecommerce and bounded advanced analysis.

prompts.title: SEO and AEO Implementation Prompt
prompts.intent: Authorised multi-platform SEO/AEO implementation, migration and programmatic pilot. Maintain required llms.txt, useful matching FAQs and numerical keyword checks; verify before/after URL evidence, preserve functionality and permissions.

prompts.title: Reddit Growth, Research & Community Engagement Prompt
prompts.intent: Use with any brand to assess Reddit fit, discover and monitor communities, improve profiles, identify opportunities, prepare useful comments and posts, manage reputation, capture customer insights and measure results. Existing brand and project standards take precedence; external actions require approval.

prompts.title: Reddit Paid Advertising & Campaign Optimisation Prompt
prompts.intent: Use independently to assess paid Reddit suitability, plan audiences and creative, verify policy and privacy requirements, prepare measurement and controlled tests, execute authorised campaigns and optimise actual performance. No spend or external account changes without approval.

prompts.title: UGC Ad Strategy, Concepts & Scripts Prompt
prompts.intent: Develop UGC advertising strategy, distinct visual and spoken hooks, format choices, audience-relevant proof, memorable brand differentiation, scripts and creative tests linked to business outcomes. Works with human creators, synthetic presenters or hybrid production.

prompts.title: AI UGC Ad Production & Quality Control Prompt
prompts.intent: Produce and verify UGC video using genuine footage, AI or hybrid methods chosen for credibility, fidelity and overall production effort. Covers product and creator references, physical interactions, claim-critical shot reviews, final export accessibility, cost-aware repairs, rights and disclosures.

prompts.title: AI Brand Image Generation & Quality Control Prompt
prompts.intent: Create and review reference-faithful brand images. Inspect actual composition, camera, anatomy, objects, text and crop, not metadata alone; ensure QA rejects plausible but visually wrong examples. Failed or unassessed mandatory criteria cannot pass. Includes a worked example.

prompts.title: Personal & Business Positioning and Messaging Strategy Prompt
prompts.intent: Develop evidence-based personal, business or combined positioning, brand voice, audiences and content themes. Includes a LinkedIn company tagline workflow with varied structures, evidence-backed claims, audience language and the 120-character limit. Independent and cross-platform. Also covers canonical links in social biographies and accurate eligible local business listings.

prompts.title: LinkedIn Personal Profile Post Writing Prompt
prompts.intent: Draft, rewrite and repurpose personal LinkedIn posts with a distinctive voice, real or clearly framed creative stories, audience-relevant hooks, approximate mobile and desktop feed-preview checks, and goal-led engagement or follower growth.

prompts.title: LinkedIn Company Page Post Writing Prompt
prompts.intent: Create company LinkedIn posts with practical customer insight, verified proof, relevant formats, decision-useful content, genuine sharing value and goal-matched calls to action. Check visible feed hooks and use approved page positioning without repeating it mechanically.

prompts.title: Content Performance Analysis & Optimisation Prompt
prompts.intent: Analyse personal and business content results across platforms with verified measurement, fair comparisons, audience response quality, indirect commercial signals and clear decisions on what to repeat, adapt or stop.

prompts.title: Audience Journey & Sales Funnel Strategy Prompt
prompts.intent: Choose a credible conversion journey for the audience and offer, including pilot validation, direct or nurtured routes, buyer and participant roles, parallel delivery planning, and outcomes beyond lead volume.

prompts.title: High-Converting Webinar Strategy, Outline & Script Creation Prompt
prompts.intent: Create brand-specific webinars with a timed teaching outline, credible proof, ethical offer transition, presenter script options, Q&A, registration and follow-up.

prompts.title: Lead Magnet Strategy, Creation & Conversion Optimisation Prompt
prompts.intent: Create or improve brand-specific lead magnets by validating audience problems, producing a complete narrow solution, selecting suitable formats and gates, preparing ethical delivery and follow-up, and evaluating qualified leads.

prompts.title: Landing Page Strategy, Copywriting, Design & Conversion Optimisation Prompt
prompts.intent: Create, implement, audit and optimise brand-specific landing pages with clear promises, credible proof, persuasive copy, genuine guarantees and deadlines, mobile accessibility, functioning conversion paths and measured results.

prompts.title: Website Blog & Article Research, Writing & Optimisation Prompt
prompts.intent: Research, write, fact-check and improve complete website articles using reader questions, original expertise, natural search optimisation, clear structure, useful links and appropriate next steps.

prompts.title: Medium Article Strategy, Writing & Distribution Prompt
prompts.intent: Research, write and refine Medium stories for real readers, with compelling openings, authentic voice, useful insights, previews, relevant topics, publication submissions, distribution and canonical-aware republishing.

prompts.title: Cross-Channel Content Opportunity Research Prompt
prompts.intent: Discover evidence-backed audience questions, real problems, underserved topics and distinct content opportunities reusable across platforms, without duplicating positioning, performance analysis or finished post writing.

prompts.title: Complete Website Content Strategy, Research & Copywriting Prompt
prompts.intent: Plan, research, write or audit complete website content. Map intent, questions, proof and keywords; apply sourced page-specific targets, credible claims, FAQs and llms.txt planning, useful comparisons and programmatic page eligibility. Independently usable.

prompts.title: Complete Marketing Strategy, Go-to-Market Planning & Execution Roadmap Prompt
prompts.intent: Independently plan complete marketing and go-to-market activity across customer research, channel choices, offers, budgets, customer lifecycle, measurement and a feasible execution roadmap. Reuses approved context without fixed documentation or forced channels.

prompts.title: Multi-Platform Paid Advertising Strategy, Operations & Measurement Prompt
prompts.intent: Independently assess, audit, plan, implement when authorised and optimise Google, Meta, LinkedIn and other applicable paid campaigns. Verifies suitability, platform rules, consent, conversion quality, budgets and actual account evidence; Reddit specialist 8.2 remains separate.

prompts.title: Cross-Platform Social Content & Repurposing Prompt
prompts.intent: Own cross-platform organic social content, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X and YouTube Shorts copy, channel-specific repurposing and editorial calendars, outside dedicated LinkedIn and Reddit prompts.

prompts.title: Social Publishing & Distribution Operations Prompt
prompts.intent: Own approved cross-platform social publishing and distribution operations, including connected publishing queues, calendars, approval, post status, duplicate prevention and platform monitoring.

prompts.title: Production Launch Readiness & Deployment Prompt
prompts.intent: Review release readiness across security, recovery, SEO, performance, integrations and monitoring. Before authorised website launches, verify metadata, favicon, copyright, placeholders, contact/footer links, buttons, responsive navigation, image optimisation, forms and recovery states. Deploy only with approval and verify actual live outcomes.

prompts.title: Client Handover & Operational Readiness Prompt
prompts.intent: Audit and complete client ownership and handover of service accounts, access, recovery, billing, assets, data, operations, support, documentation and training. Requires distinct client acceptance with evidence; no automatic transfers or account changes. Adds public policy ownership, customer data rights and production font, image and asset licence evidence.

prompts.title: Website Domain, DNS & Email Architecture Strategy Prompt
prompts.intent: Plan, audit and implement website domains, DNS, sender authentication and email architecture for business sites, ecommerce and applications. Covers canonical hostnames, transactional and marketing separation, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, consent, provider choice, safe changes and verification.

prompts.title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineering Prompt
prompts.intent: Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code delivery. Standalone infrastructure provisioning, environment architecture, repeatable IaC, access review and cloud migration are split across narrower owners

prompts.title: Resource Efficiency and Cost Optimisation Prompt
prompts.intent: Use before development, during implementation or on an existing app to compare suitable database engines and providers, model idle and growth costs, assess migration total cost and optimise infrastructure usage. Covers compute, queries, storage, development environments, hosting and approved repairs without requiring a companion prompt.

prompts.title: Ongoing Maintenance & Support Prompt
prompts.intent: Maintain applications through health checks, incidents, diagnostic history, security, dependency vulnerability and unused-package reviews, recovery, updates and costs. Check post-launch search, analytics and monitoring; verify authorised repairs.

prompts.title: Graphic Design, Brand Visuals & Editable Creative Assets Prompt
prompts.intent: Own graphic design, visual identity applications and editable social assets, including composition, typography, multi-slide consistency, exact text, print/export checks and delivery QA.

prompts.title: Video, Motion & Product Film Production Prompt
prompts.intent: Own non-UGC video, product demos, launch films and motion asset production, including treatment, storyboard, motion graphics, compositing, editing, sound, captions, exports and deliverable QA.

prompts.title: Workflow Automation & Cross-App Orchestration Prompt
prompts.intent: Own persistent cross-application workflow automation and integration operations, including triggers, multi-app authorisation, mapping, idempotent retries, schedules, alerts and operational handover.
